changelog:
v3.2.0 — Mobile Touch Overhaul

• Player touch gestures: tap for controls, double-tap play/pause, swipe to seek/zap
• Fixed poster card overflow on phone screens (responsive card sizing)
• Ripple touch feedback on all interactive cards
• Stats button in player controls (phone)
• Hero swipe gesture for featured content rotation
• Track picker responsive width + tap-to-dismiss scrim
• MultiView touch support: tap to select slot, long-press to change channel, landscape lock
• Readable text sizes on phones (11sp minimum badges)
• Boosted text contrast for daylight phone usage
• Fixed VerticalGridView position -1 crash on VOD/Series grids
